name: hami-app
description: Hami Legal System - Iraqi Legal Case Management - V1 Admin Edition

scripts.health:chunks: npm run build:chunks && node scripts/chunk-baseline.mjs diff
scripts.health:chunks:strict: npm run build:chunks && node scripts/chunk-baseline.mjs diff --fail
scripts.baseline:chunks: npm run build:chunks && node scripts/chunk-baseline.mjs save
scripts.audit:execution-chunk-scope: node scripts/audit-execution-chunk-scope.mjs && node scripts/audit-execution-heavy-modals-props.mjs && node scripts/audit-execution-overlay-component-props.mjs && node scripts/audit-execution-all-overlay-props.mjs && node scripts/audit-core-scope-runtime-bindings.mjs
scripts.test:execution: npm run audit:execution-snapshot && vitest run src/app/hooks/lawyerDashboard src/app/services/caseShare src/app/utils/__tests__/executionDossierIsolation.test.ts src/app/components/lawyer/dashboard/__tests__/useCommandCenterDockActions.test.ts src/app/components/lawyer/LawyerDashboardParts/__tests__/utils.test.ts
scripts.test:security: vitest run src/app/api/security/wifeValidator.test.ts src/app/api/security/wifeSecurityMonitor.test.ts src/app/api/security/stolenTokenServer.test.ts src/app/api/security/wifeRateLimitStore.test.ts src/app/api/security/csrfServerStore.test.ts src/app/api/security/contentSecurityPolicy.test.ts src/app/api/security/bffAuth.test.ts src/app/api/security/roleResolver.test.ts src/app/api/comms-dispatcher/route.test.ts src/app/security/__tests__/kvProxyOwnership.test.ts src/app/security/__tests__/deviceId.test.ts src/app/security/__tests__/wifeRedTeamAttack.test.ts src/app/security/__tests__/wifeFullAppDestruction.test.ts src/app/security/__tests__/wifeFullAppDestructionRoutes.test.ts src/app/security/__tests__/wifeUploadDestruction.test.ts src/app/services/__tests__/wifeFetchGuard.test.ts src/app/api/security/sanitizer.test.ts src/app/api/security/fileValidator.test.ts src/app/api/upload/route.test.ts src/app/api/upload/remove/route.test.ts src/app/api/laws/list/route.test.ts src/app/api/laws/add/route.test.ts src/app/services/server/MalwareScanService.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:profile: playwright test e2e/lawyer-profile.spec.ts e2e/lawyer-profile-header.spec.ts e2e/lawyer-profile-privacy-edit.spec.ts e2e/lawyer-profile-studio.spec.ts e2e/forum-member-profile.spec.ts --project=chromium --workers=1
scripts.release:check:settings: npm run gate:settings && npm run build && npm run test:e2e:boot -- --project=chromium && npm run test:e2e:settings
scripts.release:check:settings:mobile: npm run build && vitest run src/app/components/lawyer/HamiSettings src/app/services/settings/__tests__ src/app/context/__tests__/privacyBlurMobile.test.tsx src/app/runtime/__tests__/privacyScreenSession.test.ts src/app/runtime/__tests__/screenshotDeterrentRuntime.test.ts src/app/runtime/__tests__/nativeSecurityBoot.test.ts src/app/runtime/__tests__/nativeBiometricLifecycle.test.ts && npm run verify:native:android && npm run test:e2e:settings:mobile
scripts.test:all: npm run test:run && npm run test:e2e
scripts.health: npm run health:utf8 && npm run health:security && npm run health:case-files && npm run health:resources && npm run typecheck
scripts.release:check:repository: npm run build && npm test -- --run src/app/components/lawyer/SmartRepository src/app/hooks/lawyerDashboard/__tests__/useLawyerDashboardRepository.test.ts src/app/services/repository && npm run test:e2e:boot -- --project=chromium && npm run test:e2e:repository
scripts.release:check:forum: npm run build && npm test -- --run src/app/components/lawyer/CommunityScreen src/app/services/forum src/app/services/__tests__/forumApiService.test.ts && npm run test:e2e:boot -- --project=chromium && npm run test:e2e:forum
scripts.release:check:homeHub: npm run build && npm test -- --run src/app/components/lawyer/LawyerHomeHubCard src/app/services/alerts && npm run test:e2e:boot -- --project=chromium && npm run test:e2e:homeHub
scripts.release:check:notifications: npm run gate:notifications && npm run build && npm run test:e2e:boot -- --project=chromium && npm run test:e2e:notifications
scripts.release:check:global-search: npm run gate:global-search && npm run build && npm run test:e2e:boot -- --project=chromium && npm run test:e2e:global-search
scripts.release:check:profile: npm run gate:profile && npm run build && npm run test:e2e:boot -- --project=chromium && npm run test:e2e:profile
scripts.release:check: npm run health && npm run build && npm run health:bundle && npm run test:run
scripts.release:check:full: npm run release:check && npm run test:e2e:boot && npm run test:e2e:repository
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=hami-app
